title: How Claude Prompt Caching Actually Works
youtubeTitle: How Claude Prompt Caching Actually Works ⚡ #Shorts
youtubeDescription: Learn how Claude prompt caching reduces latency and input token costs by preserving shared context across API calls.

scenes.visualBody: Re-sending large context files on every API call slows down your pipeline.
scenes.voiceText: If you are building with Claude, re-sending entire documents on every prompt wastes substantial bandwidth.

scenes.visualBody: Cached prompt prefixes bypass repetitive context ingestion on subsequent calls.
scenes.voiceText: Prompt caching stores your system instructions in memory, allowing subsequent calls to read directly from cache.
Simply add the ephemeral cache control block to your system prompt to activate instant prefix matching.

scenes.visualBody: Place static instructions at the top and dynamic queries at the bottom to maximize cache hits.
scenes.voiceText: Structure your static context at the start of the prompt to maximize warm cache hits and minimize latency.
